name: MyOS Session Subscription Mandate
description: MyOS-hosted responder mandate allowing sessions of the inherited authorizedInitialDocument to request a provider-mediated subscription to a source logical document. The authority holder must control the source document or the explicitly constrained source session. The canonical subtype constrains the guarantor and authorized-actor roles to MyOS Admin.

sourceInitialDocument.description: Initial document whose selected session may be observed.

sourceDocumentSessionId.description: Optional concrete source session. When absent, MyOS Admin chooses an eligible session of sourceInitialDocument.

allowedAnchors.description: Optional anchors from which linked-document subscriptions may be requested. More detailed filter restrictions may be expressed through inherited validation.
